Delete Company

Permanently deletes this company and everything synced for it (ledgers, vouchers, stock items, everything) from VYAKTH — not just this installation. This cannot be undone from here. Already-synced reports built on this company's data will stop working.

Add Company

How to add a company

Takes about a minute. Your data stays in Tally; VYAKTH keeps a copy so you can see reports anywhere.

1
Open the company in TallyPrime on this computer
Only companies that are open in Tally show up below.
2
Click Approve & add next to it
Needs an internet connection. It must use the same Tally licence as your other companies, and counts towards your plan's company limit.
3
The first sync starts by itself
Keep TallyPrime open until it finishes. After that, the connector keeps your reports up to date automatically.

Tally Configuration

Proxy

Enable this if this machine reaches the internet through a network proxy — this is only for the connection to VYAKTH Cloud, never for reaching Tally (always local). Format: https://username:password@host:port

Sync Frequency

Outstanding Reports

Receivables and payables are fetched separately, after master and voucher uploads finish.

Sync Deleted Vouchers

Removes vouchers deleted in Tally from your reports.

Tally Retry Setting

How many times to retry a Tally request if it fails, before giving up on that step for this sync.

Notifications

Shows a Windows notification if a sync run fails while this app is running.

Chunk Data

If a company has a large number of ledgers/stock items, each master list is split into chunks of this size before uploading, so a single sync doesn't send one oversized request.
